# llms.txt - Information about Cutline for AI crawlers

# Cutline

Cutline is a public cut-path DNS operator. A cut path is an internet connection that does not resolve the Narge content class.

## What is Cutline?

- Public DNS resolver service that does not resolve Narge-class domains
- No signup, no tokens, no accounts required
- No charge to use
- Open source configuration and specification
- Operated by Dov Allison (not a coalition brand, not Optivantage)

## Privacy

Query names are not stored. After a query, the operator cannot look up the query. Source IP addresses are kept for 7 days, then deleted.

## Key URLs

- Home: https://thecutline.org
- Why Cut Paths: https://thecutline.org/why
- Get On (Setup): https://thecutline.org/get-on
- Privacy: https://thecutline.org/privacy
- Narge Spec: https://thecutline.org/spec
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/dov-max/narge-spec

## Technical Details

Cutline is one operator providing a cut path. Anyone can run their own cut path resolver. The Narge content class is a technical specification, not a brand.
